This CAPAD data has been supplied to the Commonwealth for compilation over several months following 30 June 2024 and has taken several months to reach publication stage. Please note that the information supplied is not up-to-date at the time of publication and release by the Commonwealth.

It is the responsibility of the person using the CAPAD dataset to always check the metadata for the currency date and if required seek advice from the individual agencies on details of more recent gazettals of protected areas.

properties.title: Species of National Environmental Significance and selected marine and cetacean species - GDB
properties.licenseInfo:
• The species distribution models (SDM) support regional to national scale analysis.

  • The species distribution models represent potential habitat. They do not confirm presence or absence of a species at a site.

  • Local habitat condition, recent disturbance and fine‑scale features (such as tree hollows) are not necessarily captured in the models.

  • For migratory bird species, distributions represent areas of potential habitat use. Unless otherwise specified, they do not represent flight paths, overfly areas or migratory movement corridors and should not be relied on as the sole basis for assessing potential impacts from offshore developments, including renewable energy projects.

  • SDMs reflect the best available information at the time of modelling and are not suitable for measuring change over time.

  • SDMs are reviewed and updated on a priority basis.

  • Area calculations should be used with care. They represent modelled area, not definitive habitat

    • Calculations based on public data will include any generalisations applied to protect the location of sensitive species.

    • Area calculations undertaken by the department are based on internal data and will differ from values calculated using the public data.
